glossEn: the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
note: the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one。线索：a / two dozen。用法：dozen 后通常不加 of（a dozen eggs），但 two dozen of 也可见到。

glossEn: denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
note: denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units。形容词面，实际英语里 dozen 本身已含这个意思，形容词用法较少见。
